executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under high pressure. Server DRAM, DRAM, HBM are currently among the most constrained areas. The Daily Check dated 2026-08-14 reviewed 8 current relevant reports; there is currently no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
